purpose: Development evaluation of the current instrument/groove working tree plus the separate native-speech vocal branch. Original prompts remain separate from expanded prompts; unsupported requests are recorded rather than silently credited.

cases.title: Sunny Sunday beach pop
cases.original: Beach vibe song for a sunny Sunday afternoon.
cases.prompt: Beach vibe song for a sunny Sunday afternoon, with warm acoustic ukulele strumming and a relaxed breezy female vocal humming a carefree hook behind the beat.

vocal.lyrics: Sun on the water. Bare feet in the sand. Stay right here with me.

gaps: Ukulele is not a dedicated instrument profile; acoustic guitar is not automatically an equivalent.
Humming, sung melody and behind-the-beat vocal performance are not provided by the speech backend.

cases.title: Sad neon midnight drive
cases.original: Midnight drive through an empty neon city with heavy nostalgic sadness.
cases.prompt: Midnight drive through an empty neon city with heavy nostalgic sadness, warm analog synths, deep bass and a low male vocal delivering long melancholic phrases with space between lines.

vocal.lyrics: Empty highway in the dark. Yesterday is miles behind. Running out of time.

gaps: Long sung legato phrases and emotional vocal dynamics remain listening goals; current output is segmented speech.

cases.title: Coffee at a rainy cabin window
cases.original: The feeling of drinking hot coffee while watching rain hit a cabin window.
cases.prompt: The feeling of drinking hot coffee while watching rain hit a cabin window. Warm intimate instrumental music, soft acoustic piano and restrained percussion, no vocals.
gaps: Rain ambience and a physically modeled cabin space are not generated.

cases.title: Anxiety into euphoric release
cases.original: Anxious heartbeat building up into sudden, euphoric relief.
cases.prompt: Anxious heartbeat building up into sudden, euphoric relief. Begin tense and sparse, build the pulse, then open into bright spacious harmony. A whispered female phrase gives way to an open sustained vocal at the release.

vocal.lyrics: Hold on. Let it go. We can breathe again.

gaps: The fixed section matrix does not implement an instructed tension-to-major harmonic trajectory.
One voice per plan cannot switch from whisper to a sung belt at the release.

cases.title: Personal-record workout anthem
cases.original: High-energy workout anthem to hit a new personal record at the gym.
cases.prompt: High-energy workout anthem to hit a new personal record at the gym, stomping drums and deep distorted bass. A commanding male vocal delivers short syncopated motivational callouts, building urgency before the drop.

vocal.lyrics: One more rep. Push through the fire. We own this ground.

gaps: Shouting intensity, syllable-aligned rap and expressive urgency are not implemented.

cases.title: Focused instrumental study beats
cases.original: Chill background study beats to maintain focus without vocal distractions.
cases.prompt: Chill background study beats to maintain focus without vocal distractions. Instrumental only, restrained warm electric piano, a soft steady groove and minimal fills. No vocals.

cases.title: Cozy indie coffee shop
cases.original: Cozy indie coffee shop background music with soft chatter in the air.
cases.prompt: Cozy indie coffee shop background music with warm acoustic guitar, a relaxed pop groove and soft chatter in the air. Keep it instrumental, with no foreground singer or intelligible lyrics.
gaps: Indie pop has no dedicated acoustic-pop preset.
Ambient crowd chatter is not generated; an intelligible speech hook would not satisfy this request.

cases.title: Dusty 90s boom-bap
cases.original: Late 90s boom-bap hip-hop with dusty vinyl crackle and a jazzy piano loop.
cases.prompt: Late 90s boom-bap hip-hop with dusty vinyl crackle and a jazzy piano loop. A confident male rap vocal sits inside a relaxed swung pocket, with clear rhythmic bars and crisp words.

vocal.lyrics: Static on the needle. Rewind the mind. Stepping through unwritten doors.

gaps: Dusty timbre is not evidence of vinyl crackle.
Continuous natural rap flow and internal rhyme timing are not implemented by word-concatenated speech.

cases.title: Vintage analog synthwave
cases.original: Modern synthwave track featuring vintage analog synthesizers and gated reverb snare drums.
cases.prompt: Modern synthwave track featuring vintage analog synthesizers and gated reverb snare drums. Keep the instrumental hook prominent, with sparse deep robotic male vocal phrases and roomy pauses.

vocal.lyrics: Neon in the rain. Follow the signal. Stay all night.

gaps: A gated-snare envelope or short stereo delay is not a calibrated gated-reverb effect.

cases.title: Psychedelic folk duet
cases.original: 1970s psychedelic folk ballad with delicate fingerpicked acoustic guitar and warm, harmonized male-female vocals.
cases.prompt: 1970s psychedelic folk ballad with delicate fingerpicked acoustic guitar and warm harmonized male-female vocals. Long drifting phrases, gentle vibrato and a floating unhurried delivery.

vocal.lyrics: Drifting past the pines. Silver moonlight in your hair. Floating through the air.

gaps: No dedicated psychedelic-folk preset or fingerpicking arranger.
The current single-voice speech plan does not produce a harmonized male-female duet, vibrato or singing.

cases.title: UK 2-step vocal chops
cases.original: Fast-paced UK garage track with syncopated 2-step rhythms and pitched-up vocal chops.
cases.prompt: Fast-paced UK garage track with syncopated 2-step rhythms and pitched-up female vocal chops. Stutter key words into a short catchy offbeat hook; preserve the broken kick groove.

vocal.lyrics: Hold on tight. Keep it moving. Stay all night.

gaps: Word chops are supported; syllable-aware chopping and sung samples are not.

cases.title: Abandoned Parisian cafe waltz
cases.original: Melancholic French accordion waltz playing softly in an abandoned street cafe.
cases.prompt: Melancholic French accordion waltz in 3/4 time, playing softly in an abandoned street cafe. Instrumental only, with a clear one-two-three lilt and no vocals.
gaps: Accordion is not a supported instrument profile; score its absence as a miss.
There is no dedicated French-waltz style or street ambience.

cases.title: Gritty Delta blues
cases.original: Gritty delta blues driven by a raw resonator slide guitar, foot-stomping percussion, and rasping male vocals.
cases.prompt: Gritty delta blues driven by a raw resonator slide guitar, foot-stomping percussion and rasping male vocals. Alternate rough short calls with lingering bent notes in a blues call-and-response groove.

vocal.lyrics: Train crying down the track. Dust on my boots. No turning back.

gaps: Delta blues, resonator slide guitar and a twelve-bar blues form are not dedicated features.
Rasp, vocal pitch bends and expressive blues call-and-response are not implemented.

cases.title: Celtic trap crossover
cases.original: Celtic traditional folk blended with modern trap 808 sub-bass and crisp rolling hi-hats.
cases.prompt: Celtic traditional folk blended with modern trap 808 sub-bass and crisp rolling hi-hats, fiddle and flute modal melodies. An airy female vocal floats in long phrases above the tight trap rhythm.

vocal.lyrics: Across the ancient stone. Echoes call me home. Fires beneath the hill.

gaps: Only one instrument occupies each melodic role; fiddle and flute cannot both be independent leads.
A Celtic melody grammar and ethereal sung legato are not implemented.

cases.title: Industrial techno and soprano
cases.original: Dark industrial techno mixed with haunting operatic soprano vocals and distorted church organs.
cases.prompt: Dark industrial techno mixed with haunting operatic soprano vocals and distorted church organs. A rigid pounding kick supports a whispered introduction that grows into a soaring sustained wail.

vocal.lyrics: Shadows swallow light. Hear the machine awaken. Total surrender.

gaps: The additive organ profile is not a distorted pipe-organ model.
Operatic soprano, evolving whisper-to-belt dynamics and sustained sung notes are unsupported.

cases.title: Shamisen cyberpunk electro
cases.original: Cyberpunk midtempo electro fused with traditional Japanese shamisen and taiko percussion.
cases.prompt: Cyberpunk midtempo electro fused with traditional Japanese shamisen and taiko percussion, gritty low synth bass and robotic vocal chops in short quantized mechanical bursts.

vocal.lyrics: System online. Overload the grid. Reboot the wire.

gaps: Shamisen and taiko have no dedicated synthesis profiles or traditional rhythm/melody grammar.
Synthetic speech is not a vocoder or phoneme-aware glitch processor.

cases.title: Sci-fi thriller tension cue
cases.original: Tense sci-fi thriller soundtrack cue featuring dissonant rising string clusters and low brass braams.
cases.prompt: Tense sci-fi thriller soundtrack cue featuring dissonant rising string clusters and low brass braams. Instrumental only, with escalating tension, no vocals and no pop lead hook.
gaps: Diatonic functional harmony does not implement instructed dissonant rising clusters.
No dedicated low-brass braam profile or cinematic tension-curve arranger.

cases.title: Heroic fantasy orchestra and choir
cases.original: Epic fantasy orchestral piece building toward a heroic brass fanfare with soaring choral chants.
cases.prompt: Epic fantasy orchestral piece building toward a heroic brass fanfare with soaring mixed choral chants. Rhythmic low chant pulses open into a grand sustained harmonic climax above strings and orchestral percussion.

vocal.lyrics: Rise as one. Stand unbroken. Carry the light.

gaps: A single native speech voice is not an SATB choir; English phrases are used instead of claiming Latin-language support.
Independent orchestral brass, choir harmonization and a fanfare/climax arranger are not implemented.

cases.title: Intimate solo piano nocturne
cases.original: Solo grand piano in a resonant concert hall playing an intimate, contemplative nocturne in rubato tempo.
cases.prompt: Solo grand piano in a resonant concert hall playing an intimate contemplative nocturne in rubato tempo. Piano only, no drums, no bass, no other instruments and no vocals.
gaps: The engine uses a fixed tempo grid; rubato is not implemented.
Short stereo delays are not a concert-hall acoustic model.

cases.title: Close indie ukulele ballad
cases.original: Acoustic indie pop ballad featuring warm ukulele strumming, glockenspiel accents, and breathy close-mic female vocals.
cases.prompt: Acoustic indie pop ballad featuring warm ukulele strumming, glockenspiel accents and breathy close-mic female vocals. Tender conversational short phrases, gentle pauses and a quiet intimate delivery.

vocal.lyrics: Jacket on the chair. Autumn in the air. Wish you could stay.

gaps: Ukulele, glockenspiel and a dedicated acoustic indie-pop preset are absent.
Close-mic breathy singing is not implemented by native speech.

cases.title: F-sharp progressive house anthem
cases.original: Uplifting progressive house track at 128 BPM in F# Major with sidechained pad chords, energetic supersaw leads, and a punchy four-on-the-floor kick.
cases.prompt: Uplifting progressive house track at 128 BPM in F# Major with sidechained pad chords, energetic supersaw lead synth melody and a punchy four-on-the-floor kick. An anthemic female vocal stutters a short hook in the build and opens into a soaring chorus at the drop.

vocal.lyrics: Feel the rush. Higher now. Light up the sky.

gaps: Bass ducking is implemented; sidechaining pad chords must be checked separately and is currently absent.
A soaring sung chorus and dense supersaw unison are not certified by an analog-lead profile.

cases.title: 174 BPM liquid D-and-B
cases.original: 174 BPM liquid drum and bass in D minor featuring rolling breakbeat variations, deep sub-bass glides, and lush Fender Rhodes chords.
cases.prompt: 174 BPM liquid drum and bass in D minor featuring rolling breakbeat variations, deep sub-bass glides and lush Fender Rhodes chords. Keep it instrumental, with no vocals so the bass and evolving drum phrases remain clear.

cases.title: 7/8 math rock
cases.original: Math rock track in 7/8 time signature at 140 BPM with clean tapped electric guitar riffs and intricate, polyrhythmic drumming.
cases.prompt: Math rock track in 7/8 time signature at 140 BPM with clean tapped electric guitar riffs and intricate, polyrhythmic drumming. Instrumental only, no vocals, with a recurring asymmetric riff.
gaps: 7/8 is supported, but math-rock guitar tapping and a dedicated electric-guitar lead are not.
Generic polyrhythmic language may not trigger the explicit 3-against-2 groove control.

cases.title: E-flat minor neo-soul pocket
cases.original: 85 BPM neo-soul groove in E-flat minor featuring a syncopated bassline, swung live drums, jazz chords, and soft electric organ swells.
cases.prompt: 85 BPM neo-soul groove in E-flat minor featuring a syncopated bassline, swung live drums, jazz chords and soft electric organ swells. A smooth female vocal sits behind the beat with short delicate phrases and subtle melodic runs.

vocal.lyrics: Midnight honey. Caught in the groove. Let the colors stay.

gaps: Melodic runs, head-voice transitions and behind-the-beat sung performance are not implemented.
One harmony role cannot independently layer full jazz keys and organ swells.

cases.title: Digital-isolation synth-pop
cases.original: Dark synth-pop track in B minor at 115 BPM with minimalist 80s drum machines, a pulsing bassline, and verse-chorus lyrics about digital isolation.
cases.prompt: Dark synth-pop track in B minor at 115 BPM with minimalist 80s drum machines and a pulsing bassline. A cold robotic male vocal uses short metronomic phrases; verses describe digital isolation and the chorus repeats a fading-signal hook.

vocal.lyrics: Terminal screen. Spaces between. Signals fading. Words drift away.

gaps: Verse phrase cycling and a repeated drop hook are supported; this is not a full verse-chorus songwriting or sung-melody system.
